text:
Alex Chen: Draft release notes for v2.8.0 uploaded to the docs drive. Primary ask: ops + oncall to confirm version pinning for dedicated and the rollback lanes before I push the internal announce.
Priya Rao: Thanks — linking the draft?
Alex Chen: https://redwood.docs/rn/v2.8.0-draft (internal). Key bits below.
DeployBot: @channel Deploy job queued: release/v2.8.0 -> staging at 2026-03-25T02:00Z. CI: green. See /deploy 42 for logs.
Samir Patel: Quick q — what are we pinning on the runtime side? We should call out quantization artifacts for the LlamaX variant.
Alex Chen: Pin list:
```
runtime_image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-20-rc3
model_variant: llamaX-quant-v1 (forced-qd16)
config_snapshot: snap-20260319-v2
```
These are the minimum compatible combos we tested.
Maya L.: OpsOnCall — do we have a rollback play if quantized model shows perf regressions?
OpsOnCall: Yes — rollback lane is: 1) immediate revert to runtime 2026-03-15 (stable) 2) switch model_variant -> llamaX-fp16-compat. That was our canary fallback during last deploy.
Priya Rao: Product concern — will changing back to fp16 affect token-level cost? Need note in RN about cost delta and user-facing degrades.
Product Lead: Prioritize adding a short blurb: "We may temporarily revert to a compatible model variant which can slightly increase cost per token; latency targets will be preserved."
Samir Patel: Ops: are there any DB schema or config changes that require migration window?
OpsOnCall: No DB migrations. There is a short config flip for cache TTLs (60s -> 30s) in dedicated pools; we can do that in the change window without downtime.
Alex Chen: Change window proposal: 03-25 02:00Z -> 03:25Z (earliest), with health checks at +5m and +15m. Will roll forward only if errors <0.5% and p95 latency within baseline.
DeployBot: Canary rollout set to 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error_rate>1.0% within 10m.
Priya Rao: I'll update the RN draft with the rollback blurb and cost note.
Maya L.: OpsOnCall, can you add the quick runbook snippet in the thread? (one-liners)
OpsOnCall: Added runbook gist in the ops repo: /ops/runbooks/v2.8-rollback.md. TL;DR: `kubectl set image ...`, `switch-config cache_ttl=60`, `prom alert silence`, `notify #incidents`
Samir Patel: Also please pin the exact model checksums in RN (not just variant name).
Alex Chen: Good call — adding sha256s now.
Product Lead: Do we want a soft internal announce now or wait until noon? If ops signs off, let's do 17:00 PT internal announce so teams have time to queue comms.
Priya Rao: 17:00 PT works for me. I'll prepare the internal blurb and publish after Alex confirms final RN.
Alex Chen: Finalizing RN edits. Target finalize by 16:30 PT. Please +1 here if you sign off on pinned versions and rollback lanes. :thumbsup:
OpsOnCall: +1
Samir Patel: +1
Priya Rao: +1
Maya L.: +1
Product Lead: +1
Alex Chen: Thanks all — will push announce at 17:00 PT unless objections by 16:30.
